summary: Implemented the rich_measure and VerticalCenter feature, unverified by test run. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, 4 cells per level, imports Measurement); rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, a width constraint to the measured maximum in __rich_console__, and a new VerticalCenter class (render, measure, repr, JupyterMixin); rich/console.py sets render options justify to "default" in print; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 unreleased with an Added subsection; tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gain the requested tests. Per instructions, no tests or repository code were run and nothing was committed. Hand-traced results match the acceptance examples (tree 11/19, VerticalCenter newline counts).
